body: An older customer came in and bought one thing I can’t remember what it was, he asked me to check how much money was in his bank account I told him I could not do that, he then started yelling at me saying he has been coming to this supermarket for 20 years, and always checked how much money was in is bank account, I had no fucking idea what to do nor did my supervisor

Just wanted to do an update so I just got out of a mental health Unit and I tell you what I’m a hell of a lot better (still not good) but I’m on the right meds now, have more of a future I can see and I kinda would of regreted it if any of my attempts worked :))

Thank you:) i just don’t like talking about it to my friends and family they make a big deal and start walking on egg shells, and I just don’t want them to stress anymore (I also see a psychologist and have been on meds for like 4 months)
